blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Convolutional neural networks (CNN) are widely used for medical image segmentation. However, they lack an inherent measure of confidence. Existing methods for estimating prediction uncertainty often require a custom network architecture and/or dedicated training setups and need to be trained from scratch. In addition, the deduction of a single confidence score per input from the uncertainty maps is not always straightforward. In this study, we explore voxel-based uncertainty estimation methods that can be added to existing segmentation pipelines without training from scratch. We also propose a novel method to estimate a single confidence score from the uncertainty maps. Our evaluations on different ROIs and modalities suggest that our confidence score can predict segmentation performance in unseen data.
blocks.zh: 革命神经网络(CNN)被广泛用于医学影像分解. 然而,它们缺乏内在的信任。 估计不确定性的现有方法往往需要定制网络架构和(或)专门的培训设置,需要从零开始培训。 此外,从不确定性图中扣除每个输入的单一信任分并不总是直截了当的. 在这项研究中,我们探索了基于Voxel的不确定性估计方法,这些方法可以被添加到现有的分块管中而无需从零开始训练. 我们还提出一种新颖的方法,从不确定地图中估计出一个单一的置信分. 我们对不同区域办事处和模式的评价表明,我们的信心得分可以预测在无形数据中的分化性能。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Deep learning models, and in particular CNNs,
are widely used in medical image segmentation [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] .
However, these models often provide little insight into their decision process [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] , and they lack an inherent measure of confidence.
The produced probability maps provide an indirect signal of confidence per voxel. However, there is no obvious way to produce a single measure of confidence for the entire image. Since CNNs are highly successful at segmentation, the probabilities are usually higher inside and around the ROI, and mostly 0 further from the ROI. This results in a sharp transition between the foreground and background, rather than a gradual increase, limiting the ability to use volume-wide statistics as a measure of confidence. While classification models output probabilities per class, which can estimate confidence, this is not available for segmentation.
blocks.zh:
深层学习模型,特别是CNN,
被广泛用于医学影像分解[1,2,3,4,5,6,7].
然而,这些模式往往对其决策过程[8、9、10]没有多少见解,而且缺乏内在的信任度。
生成的概率图提供了每个阴道的间接信任信号. 然而,对于整个形象,没有一种明显的办法来产生单一程度的信任。 从 有线电视新闻网在分区化方面非常成功,ROI内部和周围的概率通常更高,而且大多离ROI更远0. 这导致前景和背景之间的急剧过渡,而不是逐渐增加,限制了使用全量统计数据作为衡量信心的能力。 虽然分类模型每类输出概率,这可以估计信心,但这种概率不能用于分割.

blocks.en:
There has been research to overcome this shortcoming [ 11 ] , often with Bayesian frameworks.
Gal and Ghahramani [ 12 ] have shown that CNNs trained with dropout can approximate Bayesian inference by keeping dropout active during test-time and performing multiple forward passes for classification. Ghoshal et al. [ 13 ] propose Monte Carlo drop weights, and decompose predictive probabilities into aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties.
Teye et al. [ 14 ] use batch normalization layers instead of dropout. Wang et al. [ 15 ] use test-time augmentation and Monte Carlo simulation.
There have also been non-Bayesian approaches. Some methods [ 16 , 17 ] train an ensemble of models to estimate classification uncertainty. Kohl et al. [ 18 ] propose a probabilistic U-Net. Yao et al. [ 19 ] combine an aleatoric uncertainty-based correction strategy with semi-automated prompt augmentation.
Most of these approaches require dedicated architectures [ 20 ] or training an ensemble of models [ 21 ] to accomplish segmentation and confidence/uncertainty estimation simultaneously. Many of them produce an uncertainty map, but do not deduce a single score for the entire image. This limits their usability in typical medical image analysis workflows. Notably, Wang et al. [ 15 ] use the volume variation coefficient (VVC) of multiple forward passes to estimate structure-wise uncertainty.
blocks.zh:
为了克服这一缺陷,已经进行了研究[11],经常与巴伊西亚框架。
Gal和Ghahramani[12]显示,接受过辍学培训的CNN通过在测试期间保持辍学活跃和进行多次分级前传,可以大致得出贝叶斯人的推断。 Ghoshal等人(美国) [13]提议蒙特卡洛降低重量,将预测概率分解为厌食和癫痫不确定性.
泰耶等人著. [14]使用批量正常化层而不是退学. 王等编. [15]使用测试时间增强和蒙特卡洛模拟.
还有非巴耶教派的做法。 一些方法[16,17]训练了一组模型来估计分类不确定性. 科尔等人. [18]提出概率主义的U-Net. 姚等编. [19] 将基于饱和不确定性的校正策略与半自动即时增强结合.
这些办法大多需要专门的结构[20]或培训一组模型[21],以便同时完成分解和信心/不确定性估计。 他们中许多人制作一个不确定的地图,但没有推断出整个图像的单分. 这限制了它们在典型的医疗图像分析工作流程中的可用性. 值得注意的是,王等人. [15] 使用多次前传的体积变化系数(VVC)来估计结构上的不确定性。

blocks.en:
While CNNs perform well overall, a poor prediction for a particular image may lead to mistakes. Flagging uncertain predictions could provide alternatives, such as obtaining a repeat scan if there is an image quality issue. Another use case is flagging uncertain outputs in large-scale studies for visual quality control, manual correction, or exclusion from downstream analysis. Confidence scores can also be useful in active learning [ 22 , 23 ] for prioritizing low-confidence images for annotation, as these are likely not well represented in the training dataset.
Finally, a model’s ability to report its own confidence is a significant step towards explainable AI.
blocks.zh:
虽然有线电视新闻网总体表现良好,但对特定图像的预测不佳可能导致错误。 标注不确定的预测可以提供替代品,例如如果存在图像质量问题,可获得重复扫描. 另一个使用案例是在大规模研究中标出不确定的输出,用于视觉质量控制,人工校正,或者排除在下游分析之外. 在主动学习[22,23]中,信心分数还可以用于优先排列低自信图像进行注释,因为这些在培训数据集中可能没有很好的体现.
最后,一个模型报告自身信心的能力是朝向可解释的AI迈出的重要一步.

blocks.en: In this study, we use two alternatives (Sec. 2.2 ) to produce multiple predictions from a single input image, which can be readily implemented as an add-on to existing segmentation pipelines. We then explore two approaches to estimate a voxel-based uncertainty map (Sec. 2.3 ), and propose a novel method to estimate a single, image-wide confidence score (Sec. 2.4 ). We evaluate our method on placenta (ultrasound) and hippocampus (MRI) datasets to test its generalizability.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们使用两种替代品(Sec. 2.2)从单一输入图像中产生多种预测,这些预测可以很容易地作为现有分块管道的加成执行. 然后,我们探索两种方法来估计一个基于Voxel的不确定性图(Sec. 2.3),并提议一种全新的方法来估计一个单一的,全图像的置信分(Sec. 2.4). 我们评价我们在胎盘(超声波)和海马坎普斯(MRI)数据集上的方法,以测试其通用性.

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Data and Segmentation Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据和分区模型

blocks.en:
Placenta 3D ultrasound (3DUS) dataset: This dataset contains N = 210 N=210 images from 121 unique subjects in the first trimester, and N = 49 N=49 images from 41 unique subjects taken during the second trimester. Placentas were manually segmented using ITK-SNAP ( www.itksnap.org ).
Images were down-sampled to 128 × \times 128 × \times 128 voxels before training.
blocks.zh:
Placenta 3D超声波(3DUS)数据集: 本数据集包含来自第一季121个独特主题的N=210 N=210图像,第二季拍摄的41个独特主题的N=49 N=49图像. Placentas使用ITK-SNAP(www.itksnap.org)手动分解。
图像在训练前被下取样到128×时128×时128×时128伏克斯.

blocks.en: Automated quantification of the placenta from 3DUS data is challenging [ 24 ] , and quick identification of sub-optimal segmentations during clinical screening can allow the option of a repeat scan while the patient is still in the clinic.
blocks.zh: 从3DUS数据对胎盘进行自动化量化具有挑战性[24],在临床筛选中快速识别出不理想的片段,可以让患者在门诊时选择重复扫描.

blocks.en:
Hippocampus MRI dataset: We used the hippocampus task from the Medical Segmentation Decathlon [ 25 ] . We used the N = 260 N=260 training set with anterior and posterior hippocampus labels.
Images were up-sampled to 64 3 voxels.
blocks.zh:
Hippocampus磁共振数据集 : 我们利用了医学分会的河马队任务 我们使用N=260N=260的训练装置,并带有前身和后身的河马营标签。
图像被检测到64 3瓶毒液。

blocks.en: Segmentation: We employed typical 2D and 3D U-Net models with 2 levels of down / up-sampling, and skip-connections. All convolutional layers have 3 2 3^{2} ( 3 3 3^{3} ) pixel (voxel) kernels. The placenta dataset has a single ROI. The hippocampus dataset has 2 ROIs (anterior/posterior), and we trained a separate model per ROI. We used binary cross-entropy loss.
blocks.zh: 分割 : 我们采用了典型的2D型和3D型U-Net型,有2级下/上采样和跳转连接. 所有演化层都有3 2 3^{2}(3 3^{3}3})像素(voxel)内核. 胎盘数据集有一个单独的ROI. 河马群数据集有2个ROI(外/外),我们每个ROI训练一个单独的模型. 我们用二进制的交叉输掉。

blocks.en:
For our 2D models for both the placenta and the hippocampus, we observed that a single model can be successfully trained on sagittal and coronal slices, since the general shape and position of the ROI are roughly similar along these axes. Slices along the axial plane differ considerably from the other 2 planes, and inclusion in training significantly lowered performance. Therefore, our final 2D models were trained on sagittal and coronal slices.
The placenta model has 364K trainable parameters, while the two 2D hippocampus models each have 162K. We also trained 3D models for each hippocampus ROI (1,938K trainable parameters each).
We used 4-fold cross-validation.
Since our focus is not on segmentation accuracy, but rather on the performance of confidence scoring on the test set, we used 1 partition for training and 3 for testing within each fold to provide more test cases, rather than the usual 3:1 train/test split. The random partitioning for placentas was based on the unique subjects to avoid leakage.
blocks.zh:
对于胎盘和河马的2D模型,我们观测到,一个单一的模型可以成功地训练成星形和冠状切片,因为ROI的一般形状和位置在这些轴上大致相似. 沿轴平面的切片与其他两架飞机差别很大,在训练中的融入显著降低了性能. 因此,我们最后的2D型机车被训练为agi和冠片.
胎盘模型有364K可列车参数,而两个2D的河马模型各有162K. 我们还为每个河马营ROI(每个1,938K可训练参数)培训了3D模型.
我们用了4倍的交叉验证
由于我们的重点不在于分解精度,而是在于测试集中信任分数的性能,我们使用1个分区用于训练,3个分区用于每个折叠内测试,以提供更多的测试案例,而不是通常的3:1列车/测试分数. 胎盘的随机分割是基于独特的主体以避免渗漏.

blocks.en: 2.2 Test-time augmentation strategies
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 试验时间增强战略

blocks.en: Test-time flip augmentations: We used test-time augmentation with horizontal/vertical flips for the 2D models. We thus applied a combination of 4 augmentations per 2D slice. As our models were trained on both the sagittal and coronal planes, we produced 8 full-volume 3D outputs per input.
blocks.zh: 测试时间翻转增强: 我们在2D型机车中采用了水平/垂直翻转的测试时间增强. 因此,我们采用了每2D片4个增强的组合。 由于我们的模型都接受了关于星座飞机和日冕飞机的培训,我们每次投入都产生了8个全卷3D输出.

blocks.en: This approach was viable for our 2D models, since the random online augmentations during training included the horizontal/vertical flips. Specifically, for training the placenta model, we used horizontal/vertical flips, in-plane rotations, cropping, blurring, and gamma adjustment. For the hippocampus models, we only applied horizontal/vertical flips. It is common practice to utilize random augmentations like these during training, and modifying the test-time loop to include the flip augmentations and produce multiple outputs per input is a straightforward approach to apply our confidence scoring method to existing segmentation pipelines.
blocks.zh: 这种方法对我们的2D模型是可行的,因为培训期间的随机在线增强包括横向/纵向翻转。 具体地说,为了训练胎盘模型,我们使用了水平/垂直翻转,飞机内旋转,裁剪,模糊,以及伽马调整. 对于河马模型,我们只应用水平/垂直翻转. 通常的做法是在培训期间使用这种随机扩增,修改试验时间循环,以包括翻转扩增,并产生每次输入的多种产出,这是将我们的信心评分方法应用于现有分块管道的直截了当的做法。

blocks.en: Test-time noise augmentations: Some models may perform worse with test-time flips, e.g., if augmentations were not used during training, or if the ROI is highly asymmetric. To test our method’s applicability in such cases, we trained two 3D models for the two hippocampus ROIs without any augmentations. At test-time, we added random Gaussian noise ( t ​ o ​ r ​ c ​ h . r ​ a ​ n ​ d ​ n × 0.5 torch.randn\times 0.5 ) to a random 20% subset of the voxels. We blurred ( σ = 1 \sigma=1 ) the noise before adding to the original image for a more realistic look. For each input, we produced 15 noisy versions, resulting in 16 outputs. While other noise distributions may be more suitable for various modalities, this general approach is applicable to any existing 2D or 3D models, whether augmentations were used during training or not.
blocks.zh: 试验时间噪音增强: 一些型号在测试时间翻转时表现可能更差,例如,如果在训练期间没有使用增强功能,或者ROI高度不对称. 为了检验我们的方法在此类情况下的适用性,我们培训了两个海马营ROI的两款三维模型,而没有任何增强。 在测试时,我们将随机的高斯噪声(t o r c h. r a n d × 0.5 火炬.randn\times 0.5)加入一个随机的20%的 voxel 子集. 在添加到原始图像中以进行更现实的外观之前,我们先将噪音模糊(\\\sigma=1). 每次输入,我们共制作了15个吵闹的版本,产生了16个产出。 虽然其他噪声分布可能更适合各种模式,但这种一般方法适用于任何现有的2D或3D模式,无论在培训期间是否使用增强剂.

blocks.en: 2.3 Uncertainty estimation strategies
blocks.zh: 2.3 不确定性估计战略

blocks.en: Standard deviation (stdev): First, we simply calculate the voxel-wise stdev of the multiple probability maps. We normalize to [0, 1] via min-max scaling. This gives us an approximate uncertainty map u ⁡ ( x ) u(x) , in which values close to 0.0 denote voxels where the multiple predictions mostly agree, and values close to 1.0 denote the most disagreement. As expected, we usually observed highest uncertainty along the boundary of the ROI (Fig. 1 c), as well as in regions with artifacts or other noise. We used this approach in our 2D models.
blocks.zh: 标准偏差( stdev) : 首先,我们简单计算出 多种概率图的阴性。 我们通过最小的缩放来正常化为[0, 1]. 这给了我们一个大致的不确定性图u(x)u(x)u(x),其中接近0.0的值表示多种预测基本一致的voxels,接近1.0的值表示分歧最大的. 正如预期的那样,我们通常在ROI(图1c)边界沿线以及在有文物或其他噪音的地区观察到最大的不确定性。 我们在二维模型中采用了这种方法。

blocks.en: Entropy: When the multiple predictions all have a probability close to 0.5 for a given voxel, since there is agreement, the low stdev registers as a low uncertainty voxel, even though the 0.5 probabilities suggest high uncertainty. To remedy this, we also calculated the binary entropy H ⁡ ( p ) = − p ​ ln ⁡ p − ( 1 − p ) ​ ln ⁡ ( 1 − p ) H(p)=-p\ln p-(1-p)\ln(1-p) for all the outputs and took their voxel-wise mean. In our 3D models, we min-max scaled this mean entropy map, and averaged it with the stdev map u ⁡ ( x ) u(x) (Fig. 2 ).

blocks.en: 2.4 Confidence score estimation
blocks.zh: 2.4 (中文(简体) ). 信心分数估计

blocks.en: We use the voxel-wise mean of the multiple output probability maps to create a final probability map p ⁡ ( x ) p(x) and threshold it to create a binary mask M 0 ( x ) = { p ( x ) ≥ 0.50 } M_{0}(x)=\{p(x)\geq 0.50\} (Fig. 1 d).
blocks.zh: 我们使用多输出概率图的 voxel-wise 平均值来创建最终概率图 p ⁡ (x) p (x) 并设定其阈值来创建二进制面具 M 0 (x) = { p (x) 0.50 } M _{ (x) =\{ p (x)\ geq 0.50 \} (图 1 d).

blocks.en:
Next, we calculated a base mask volume V 0 = | M 0 ​ ( x ) | V_{0}=|M_{0}(x)| .
This volume is independent of the uncertainty u ⁡ ( x ) u(x) , since it includes all voxels that have p ⁡ ( x ) ≥ 0.50 p(x)\geq 0.50 regardless of uncertainty. If we introduce an uncertainty constraint such that only voxels under a given uncertainty are allowed, e.g., u ⁡ ( x ) ≤ 0.9 u(x)\leq 0.9 , then the segmentation would be more conservative and thus the resultant mask volume would be lower than V 0 V_{0} .
We observe that if the overall model prediction for a given image I ⁡ ( x ) I(x) was highly confident, there would be very few voxels with a high uncertainty u ⁡ ( x ) u(x) . Conversely, in a low-confidence prediction, there would be high uncertainty in substantially more voxels. This leads to the intuition that if the mask volume decreases rapidly as we tighten the uncertainty constraint, then the confidence for the prediction as a whole is likely low. In contrast, a very gradual decrease in volume suggests low uncertainty and high confidence (Fig. 3 a, 3 b).
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们计算出一个底部面具卷 V 0 = | M 0 (x) | V_{ 0 }=| M_{ } (x) |.
此量独立于不确定性 u ⁡( x) u( x) ,因为它包括所有拥有 p ⁡( x) 的 voxels 0.50 p( x)\ geq 0.50 ,无论不确定. 如果我们引入一种不确定性的制约,这样就只允许在特定不确定性条件下的阴道,例如u ⁡(x) ≤ 0.9 u(x)\leq 0.9,那么分化会更加保守,因此产生的面具体积会低于V 0 V_{0}.
我们观察到,如果给定的图像I QQ(x) I(x)的总体模型预测是高度自信的,那么极少数的voxels具有很高的不确定性u QX(x) u(x) u(x). 反之,在低信心的预测中,在多得多的排泄物中会有很高的不确定性. 这导致了一种直觉,即如果我们在收紧不确定性制约的同时,面具体积迅速下降,那么对整个预测的信心就可能很低. 与此相反,量的逐步减少表明不确定性低,信任度高(图3a、3b)。

blocks.en: To quantify this intuitive concept, we introduced N u N_{u} uncertainty constraints decreased by uniform steps Δ u = 1 / N u \Delta_{u}=1/N_{u} , and calculated N u − 1 N_{u}-1 more masks similarly to M 0 M_{0} . In our experiments, we empirically used N u = 10 N_{u}=10 and therefore Δ u = 0.1 \Delta_{u}=0.1 . Thus, for example, M 1 M_{1} is the set of voxels in the segmentation that have a corresponding uncertainty of less than 0.90 ( p ⁡ ( x ) ≥ 0.50 ∧ u ⁡ ( x ) ≤ 0.90 p(x)\geq 0.50\land u(x)\leq 0.90 ), and M 2 M_{2} only includes voxels in the mask that have an uncertainty less than 0.80. In general, for i ∈ [ 0 , N u − 1 ] i\in[0,N_{u}-1] , we have M i ( x ) = { p ( x ) ≥ 0.5 ∧ u ( x ) ≤ ( 1 − i ∗ Δ u ) } M_{i}(x)=\{p(x)\geq 0.5\ \land u(x)\leq(1-i*\Delta_{u})\} , with volume V i = | M i ​ ( x ) | V_{i}=|M_{i}(x)| .

As mentioned above, M 0 M_{0} is the largest mask and the volumes decrease through V 0 V_{0} to V N u − 1 V_{N_{u}-1} . How these volumes change is informative (Fig. 3 a vs. 3 b).
To capture this, we calculated the N u − 1 N_{u}-1 ratios of each volume to the base volume, V i / V 0 V_{i}/V_{0} , for i ∈ [ 1 , N u − 1 ] i\in[1,N_{u}-1] . We also calculated the N u − 2 N_{u}-2 ratios of consecutive steps, V i + 1 / V i V_{i+1}/V_{i} , for i ∈ [ 1 , N u − 2 ] i\in[1,N_{u}-2] . Since the volumes are monotonically decreasing from V 0 V_{0} through V N u − 1 V_{N_{u}-1} , all of these ratios are in the [0, 1] range.

We note that simply averaging u ⁡ ( x ) u(x) across V 0 V_{0} would be sensitive to object size, without a straightforward way to compare different subjects. Our formulation transforms the uncertainty map u ⁡ ( x ) u(x) to a series of volumetric measures V i V_{i} , allowing us to compare different subjects by simply expressing the volumes as the ratio V i / V 0 V_{i}/V_{0} . The Δ u \Delta_{u} determines the granularity of this transformation, and we found 0.1 to be adequate for our purposes.

blocks.en: 2.5 Correlation with Dice and outlier detection
blocks.zh: 2.5 与Dice和外围探测的关联

blocks.en:
We examined the correlation of our confidence C C with the segmentation Dice.
We also used these scores to identify poor segmentations. To do this in unsupervised manner, we applied an elliptic envelope model to the confidence scores (without taking Dice as input), fitting an ellipsoid around the central cluster of the data points, to separate inliers from outliers. We used the scikit-learn implementation of the model, with a contamination value of 0.1.
Since we were interested in only the abnormally low confidence cases, we filtered out cases with above mean confidence (i.e., the highest confidence scores) from the outlier set.
We then performed a two-tailed t-test to assess Dice differences between inliers and outliers.
blocks.zh:
我们研究了CC与分叉的关联性
我们还利用这些分数来辨别差分。 为了在不受监督的情况下做到这一点,我们对置信分数采用了椭圆信封模型(不以Dice为输入),在数据点的中心集群周围安装椭圆形,将插座与离座分开. 我们使用了该模型的scikit-learn执行,其污染值为0.1.
由于我们只对异常低信心案例感兴趣,我们以高于平均信心(即最高信心分数)的方式从超值中过滤出案例。
然后,我们进行了一个双尾T测试,以评估阴极和阴极之间的阴极差异。

blocks.en: 2.6 Using confidence to select annotation candidates
blocks.zh: 2.6 利用信心选择注解候选人

blocks.en:
We also explored how confidence scores can be used to select images to annotate and add to the training set from a pool of unlabeled candidates. We trained a base 2D model (Sec. 2.1 ) on 21 random images from the N = 121 N=121 placenta dataset. We split the remaining images into N = 60 N=60 test set, and N = 40 N=40 annotation candidates.
Using the base model, we produced segmentations and confidence scores for the N = 40 N=40 candidates. We compared 5 strategies for selecting candidates: best Dice, worst Dice, best confidence, worst confidence, and random. We note that the best/worst Dice strategies were included as oracle baselines, and would not be available in practice, while confidence can be computed with the base model. We added the images selected by each strategy to the N = 21 N=21 base set in increments of 5 images, and trained new models. Since the number of images in the training set were limited, we trained 3 models for each scenario with different random seeds. We compared performance on the N = 60 N=60 test set.
blocks.zh:
我们还探讨了如何利用信心分数来选择图象来注释,并增加未加标签的候选人的训练内容。 我们在来自N=121 N=121胎盘数据集的21个随机图像上训练了一个基础2D模型(Sec 2.1). 我们把剩下的图像分为N=60N=60测试集,N=40N=40注释候选.
使用基准模型,我们为N=40 N=40的考生制作了分数和信心分数. 我们比较了选择候选人的5种策略:最佳的Dice,最糟糕的Dice,最佳的信心,最糟糕的信心,以及随机的. 我们注意到,最佳/最糟糕的Dice战略已作为甲骨文基线列入,实际上无法提供,而信心可以用基准模型计算。 我们在N=21 N=21的基数中增加了每种策略所选择的图像,增加了5个图像的增量,并培训了新的模型。 由于训练集中的图像数量有限,我们用不同的随机种子为每个场景训练了3个模型. 我们比较了N=60 N=60测试集的性能.

blocks.en: 3 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 3 结果和讨论

blocks.en: Compared methods: We compare our confidence score to the volume variation coefficient (VVC) method [ 15 ] for estimating a volume-wide confidence. Other methods noted in the Introduction do not produce a volume-wide score.
blocks.zh: 比较方法 : 我们把我们的置信分数与体积变化系数(VVC)方法[15]进行比较,以估计体积全置信度. 导言中提到的其他方法不产生全卷分数。

blocks.en: 2D models: For the 2D models, we used flip augmentations during test-time, and estimated uncertainty with standard deviation (Fig. 4 ). For the placenta , the mean Dice was between 0.81-0.82 across the 4 folds. Using confidence C C , the mean Dice difference between inliers-outliers were in the range 0.14-0.23. We note that the outlier detection only uses C C , and the t-test is between the associated Dice scores rather than C C (which would be lower in the outlier group, by construction). The inlier-outlier Dice difference was 0.07-0.10 with VVC. For anterior hippocampus , mean Dice was between 0.84-0.85. Inlier-outlier Dice difference was 0.09-0.11 for C C and 0.04-0.08 for VVC. For posterior hippocampus , the mean Dice was between 0.82-0.84. Inlier-outlier Dice difference was 0.08-0.21 for C C and 0.05-0.21 for VVC.

For anterior hippocampus (not shown for brevity), the mean Dice was between 0.83-0.84. Inlier-outlier Dice difference was 0.05-0.07 with confidence, and 0.05-0.07 with VVC. For posterior hippocampus (Fig. 5 ), the mean Dice was between 0.79-0.81. Inlier-outlier Dice difference was 0.08-0.14 with confidence, and 0.07-0.14 with VVC. The inlier-outlier differences were significant for each fold ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ) for both C and VVC, in both 2D and 3D models.

blocks.en: Selection by confidence: Fig. 6 shows the mean test performance for each selection strategy, where N = 0 N=0 is the base model. Adding images with the worst Dice/confidence scores improves test performance faster than other strategies. The Dice scores of the “worst confidence” strategy were significantly better than the “random” strategy for the smaller N ( p < 0.01 p<0.01 for N ∈ { 5 , … , 20 } N\in\{5,...,20\} , and p < 0.03 p<0.03 for N = 25 N=25 in paired t-tests). The performances converge, as expected, as we approach the entire candidate pool size, with the random strategy performing better at N = 30 N=30 ( p < 0.03 p<0.03 ).

blocks.en:
Discussion: We proposed a novel method to estimate a single confidence score for CNNs used in medical image segmentation,
by examining how rapidly the segmentation volume decreases as we gradually allow less uncertainty.
blocks.zh:
讨论: 我们提出一种新颖的方法来估计 医疗图像分解中使用的CNN的单一信任分数,
通过研究分解量如何迅速减少 随着我们逐渐减少不确定性。

blocks.en:
Our confidence score C C is highly correlated with the segmentation Dice. We observe that the upper left quadrant of the plots in Figs. 4 and 5 is typically empty, i.e., C C is rarely high for low-Dice predictions in our experiments. This suggests high sensitivity, which is useful for practical workflows. C C values are usually in the range of 0.60-0.90, and most cases with low Dice receive a C C below 0.75. The unsupervised outlier detection experiment confirms this finding.
For each ROI in Fig. 4 , VVC fails to flag several low-Dice ( < 0.6 <0.6 ) cases that our method successfully captures (red arrows). Compared to VVC, our method has more consistent performance for a given task: e.g., for the anterior hippocampus (Fig. 4 , middle row), the VVC correlations fluctuate from -0.247 to -0.668, whereas our correlations are stable in the [0.699, 0.711] range. Our correlations and inlier-outlier differences substantially surpass VVC counterparts in most experiments.
blocks.zh:
我们的C级信心分数与分化的Dice高度相关。 我们观察了菲格斯地块的左上角 4和5一般是空的,即CC在我们的实验中对于低剂量的预测很少是高的. 这表明高度敏感,对实际工作流程有用。 C C值通常在0.60-0.90之间,低二极管的病例大多得到低于0.75的C. 无监督的外部探测实验证实了这一发现.
为法格的每个ROI. 4, VVC 未能标出数个低分量( < 0.6 < 0.6) 我们的方法成功捕获(红箭)的案例. 与VVC相比,我们的方法对特定任务具有更一致的性能:例如,对于前河马(图4,中行),VVC的关联性从-0.247到-0.668,而我们的关联性在[0.699,0.711]范围内是稳定的. 在大多数实验中,我们的相关性和越高越大的差异大大超过VVC。

blocks.en:
In our experiments we used test-time flips and Gaussian noise. These or other suitable augmentations may be used for new tasks.
More extensive evaluation remains as future work.
blocks.zh:
在我们的实验中,我们使用了测试时间翻转和高斯噪音。 这些或其他合适的增强装置可用于新的任务。
今后的工作仍然是进行更广泛的评价。

blocks.en:
Our proposed confidence score C C shows a strong correlation with Dice in our extensive experiments, reliably indicating segmentation quality.
Our method’s compatibility with existing segmentation pipelines and its applicability without requiring specialized architectures make it a versatile tool. This technique can help in many scenarios such as identifying poor-quality inputs or for selecting images for manual segmentation. Overall, our approach contributes a valuable layer of uncertainty estimation and quality control, enhancing the potential for increased clinical adoption of CNNs. Application in clinic remains as future work. Our code is available at github.com/MedICL-VU/segmentation-confidence .
blocks.zh:
我们提出的CC信心分数显示,在我们广泛的实验中,Dice与Dice有很强的关联性,可靠地表明分化的质量.
我们的方法与现有的分块管道的兼容性及其在不需要专门结构的情况下的适用性使它成为一个多功能的工具。 这种技术在许多情况下可以有所帮助,例如确定质量差的投入或选择图象进行人工分解。 总的来说,我们的方法有助于形成一个宝贵的不确定性估计和质量控制层,提高临床上更多地采用CNN的潜力。 申请继续作为未来工作。 我们的代码在github.com/MedICL-VU/siementation-confession.
